description: Search TripAdvisor destinations, cities, hotels, attractions, and restaurants by query (e.g. "Paris" or "Santorini hotels") to obtain geo_id / location_id, ratings, review counts, and coordinates. Cost: 5 Credits / location returned.

query.description: Destination, hotel, attraction, or restaurant name, e.g. "Paris" or "Tokyo Shibuya".

name: tripadvisor_search

data.description: Normalized search results containing matching businesses, employers, destinations, or ranked restaurants with ratings and identifiers.

meta.description: Gateway billing and cache telemetry (credits_charged, credits_remaining, cache hit/miss, latency_ms).

title: Search TripAdvisor Destinations, Hotels & Hospitality Locations
